item: Operating profit per operational P&L (monthly_pnl, pre-existing dashboards)
+ Imputed inventory financing cost removed (replaced by actual interest below EBIT)
+/- Retail returns timing: GP of later-returned lines sold in window less GP reversed by refunds in window
- Inventory shrinkage & damaged write-offs (movement records; not in operational P&L)
+/- Service recognition timing: GP of orders completed in window less GP of orders received in window
- Depreciation of fixed assets (not in operational P&L)
= Explained GL EBIT
